authorization_scope: P04 revalidates exact full A1 using the committed P03 adapter fix, then only on success validates the nine direct partitions, specified controls, and completeness method. IEEE S-C01 is excluded.

a1_route.required_submission: exact full file text with only the terminal LF stripped by shell command substitution

source_draft_preparation.pre_live_current_draft_audit: Audit all current nine query files against dictionary v4, preserve one prospective cell per semantic partition, and record current pair distance without changing source files.
source_draft_preparation.field_free_text_route: Use individually fielded All Metadata predicates, quoted normative terms, explicit Boolean parentheses, no wildcards, and no controlled-vocabulary supplement.
source_draft_preparation.controlled_vocabulary: Do not reopen the unusable hierarchy/mapping/explosion route unless a current contradiction is observed.

pair_fallback.rationale: A same-field NEAR/6 fallback cannot lose a protocol pair with no more than five intervening tokens under either common endpoint/intervening counting convention, but can admit one extra intervening token.
pair_fallback.semantic_status: broader implementation pending human approval; not exact equivalence
pair_fallback.precondition: Run only the four predeclared generic NEAR/6 diagnostics successfully before rewriting pair-bearing drafts.

browser_and_source_safety.anchor_requirement: Preserve the controller-provided original about:blank anchor before, during, and after every logical source batch without recording its identifier in tracked evidence.
browser_and_source_safety.serialization: All source actions are serial; use an adapter-owned page only and a respectful delay between actions.
stop_conditions: login, CAPTCHA, challenge, access-control state, or source-boundary failure
browser version, anchor, power, sleep/wake, or assertion failure
query rewrite, null/unreconciled total, parser/control failure, duplicate/missing identity, detail failure, or incomplete event

require: exact numeric total or native explicit zero
safe owned-page closure and anchor census

queries: forward: individually fielded power NEAR/6 system
reverse: individually fielded system NEAR/6 power
grouped: (power OR energy) NEAR/6 (system OR subsystem), all individually fielded
distributed: OR of the four equivalent individually fielded NEAR/6 pairs
require: exact echo and numeric/nonzero-or-native-zero total for every diagnostic
gated_operations.success_disposition: Regenerate all nine source drafts from dictionary v4 with NEAR/6 only in pair rules, then audit hashes, terms, Boolean trees, one-cell mapping, and pair grouping.

gated_operations.a1_handling: A1 is the A1-fix-gate result and must not be rerun.
require: exact numeric total or native explicit zero
gated_operations.failure_disposition: stop immediately; no partial partition set is accepted

operations: one generic individually fielded CubeSat AND MBSE count-only query with visible publication-year range 2011 through execution year 2026; label it diagnostic, not the common cutoff
one generic individually fielded CubeSat AND MBSE count-only query with visible Journals plus Conferences controls; do not adopt the restriction
one safe rendered Advanced Search structural language-facet/control inventory using one temporary restricted Playwright page and an allowlisted projection; do not apply English
require: temporary structural page closes and anchor remains safe

gated_operations.settings: deterministically set limit and max-pages at or above successful A1 total; default full rendered detail/abstract/DOI reconciliation
require: source total equals retrieved total in each pass
stable nonempty article-number identity per record

ordered_queries: Q1: individually fielded CubeSat AND MBSE
Q2: individually fielded nanosatellite AND MBSE
Q3: individually fielded CubeSat AND SysML
gated_operations.selection_rule: Select the first exact total from 11 through 50 inclusive; do not inspect records. If none qualifies, mark multipage completeness blocked without altering terms.
gated_operations.selected_capture: If selected, run two complete passes at native page size 10 with limit/max-pages high enough to exhaust the selected total and --skip-full-abstracts.
require: source total equals retrieved total in each pass
gated_operations.failure_disposition: stop P04; a no-selection result is a documented blocked completeness check, not an adaptive query

prospective_method_decision.rendered_adapter_capture: May be proposed as the prospective equivalent method only if both the small full-detail repeat and selected multipage repeat pass. Native export remains untested/not required and no REST citation endpoint may be used.
prospective_method_decision.language: Expected conservative disposition is no native English restriction and screening-time full-report language determination unless reliability is demonstrated.
prospective_method_decision.pair_fallback: NEAR/6 remains a broader, protocol-permitted implementation pending human approval even if diagnostic syntax/equality checks pass.
prospective_method_decision.final_status: Pending controller and human review; this pilot cannot self-approve.

required: validate new manifest schema and evidence hashes
validate query hashes/algebra and restricted inventory
